A '''heavy weapons repulsorlift platoon''' was a formation in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Arranged similarly to a standard [[repulsorlift platoon]], a heavy weapons repulsorlift platoon comprised four [[heavy weapons repulsorlift squad]]s, a command element, and a support vehicle. A heavy weapons repulsorlift platoon could be augmented by the addition of four extra heavy weapons repulsorlift squads.<ref name="ISB2" />
